items.headline: FDA approves immunotherapy that may spare some rectal cancer patients from chemo, radiation and surgery
items.summary: The FDA granted accelerated approval to GSK's Jemperli, also called dostarlimab, as a standalone treatment for adults with untreated stage two or three rectal cancer that has a specific genetic profile known as mismatch repair deficiency. In a trial of 154 patients followed for more than two years, almost three in four needed no surgery, radiation or chemotherapy.
items.why_it_matters: For a subset of rectal cancer patients, six months of immunotherapy alone could replace treatments that often cause infertility, bowel dysfunction or a permanent colostomy.

items.headline: Japan launches first mission to land on Mars's moon Phobos and return samples
items.summary: Japan's space agency launched its Martian Moons Exploration spacecraft on an H3 rocket, and declared the launch a success once the probe separated from the rocket about an hour later. The craft should reach Mars next August, deploy a French and German rover, collect at least ten grams of Phobos soil and bring it back to Earth in 2031.
items.why_it_matters: No spacecraft has ever landed on either of Mars's moons, so returned samples could settle how they formed and add to what we know about the early solar system.
